page.layout: One scanned image showing the closed book: a cream vellum or limp parchment binding seen from the front cover, on a dark background. No printed text block is visible. Only binding stains, a small paper label fragment and a manuscript mark on the spine edge at left are present.
page.notes: The scan shows the outside of a binding, not a printed page. The faint brown marks on the left edge are a spine label remnant and a few ink strokes, which are handwriting or staining and are not transcribed. Round brown stains on the lower cover are binding damage. No printed words are legible, so there is no main text.
